dhpak1.7:2.2: upanissāya siṃsapāvane viharanto cūḷakāḷamahākāḷe ārabbha kathesi.
dhpak1.7:3.1: Setabyanagaravāsino hi cūḷakāḷo, majjhimakāḷo, mahākāḷoti tayo bhātaro kuṭumbikā.
dhpak1.7:3.2: Tesu jeṭṭhakaniṭṭhā disāsu vicaritvā pañcahi sakaṭasatehi bhaṇḍaṃ āharanti,
dhpak1.7:3.4: Athekasmiṃ samaye te ubhopi bhātaro pañcahi sakaṭasatehi nānābhaṇḍaṃ gahetvā
dhpak1.7:3.5: sāvatthiṃ gantvā sāvatthiyā ca jetavanassa ca antare sakaṭāni mocayiṃsu.
dhpak1.7:4.1: Tesu mahākāḷo sāyanhasamaye mālāgandhādihatthe sāvatthivāsino ariyasāvake dhammassavanāya gacchante disvā
dhpak1.7:4.2: “ kuhiṃ ime gacchantī ” ti pucchitvā tamatthaṃ sutvā “ ahampi gamissāmī ” ti cintetvā
dhpak1.7:4.4: “ tāta, tesu sakaṭesu appamatto hohi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ sotuṃ gacchāmī ”
dhpak1.7:4.5: ti vatvā gantvā tathāgataṃ vanditvā parisapariyante nisīdi.
dhpak1.7:5.1: Satthā taṃ disvā tassa ajjhāsayavasena anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathento
dhpak1.7:5.3: anekapariyāyena kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesañca kathesi.
dhpak1.7:5.4: Taṃ sutvā mahākāḷo “ sabbaṃ kira pahāya gantabbaṃ,
dhpak1.7:5.5: paralokaṃ gacchantaṃ neva bhogā, na ñātakā ca anugacchanti,
dhpak1.7:5.7: ti cintetvā mahājane satthāraṃ vanditvā pakkante satthāraṃ pabbajjaṃ yācitvā
dhpak1.7:6.1: satthārā “ natthi te koci apaloketabbo ” ti vutte,
dhpak1.7:6.2: “ kaniṭṭho me, bhante, atthī ” ti vatvā tena hi “ apalokehi nan ” ti vutte,“ sādhu, bhante ” ti vatvā
dhpak1.7:6.3: gantvā kaniṭṭhaṃ pakkosāpetvā,“ tāta, imaṃ sabbaṃ sāpateyyaṃ paṭipajjāhī ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:6.4: “ Tumhe pana kiṃ karissatha bhātikā ” ti? “ Ahaṃ satthu santike pabbajissāmī ” ti.
dhpak1.7:6.5: So taṃ nānappakārehi yācitvā nivattetuṃ asakkonto
dhpak1.7:6.6: “ sādhu, sāmi, yathā ajjhāsayaṃ karothā ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:6.7: Mahākāḷo gantvā satthu santike pabbaji. cūḷakāḷopi pabbaji.
dhpak1.7:7.1: Aparabhāge mahākāḷo upasampadaṃ labhitvā satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā
dhpak1.7:7.4: “ ahaṃ, bhante, mahallakakāle pabbajitattā ganthadhuraṃ pūretuṃ na sakkhissāmi,
dhpak1.7:7.5: vipassanādhuraṃ pana pūressāmī ” ti yāva arahattā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathāpetvā sosānikadhutaṅgaṃ samādāya
dhpak1.7:7.6: paṭhamayāmātikkante sabbesu niddaṃ okkantesu susānaṃ gantvā
dhpak1.7:8.3: “ ko nu kho idhāgacchati, pariggaṇhissāmi nan ”
dhpak1.7:8.5: ekadivasaṃ susānakuṭikāyameva dīpaṃ jāletvā puttadhītaro ādāya gantvā ekamante nilīyamānā
dhpak1.7:8.6: majjhimayāme theraṃ āgacchantaṃ disvā gantvā vanditvā,“ ayyo, no, bhante, imasmiṃ ṭhāne viharatī ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:8.7: “ Āma, upāsike ” ti. “ Bhante, susāne viharantehi nāma vattaṃ uggaṇhituṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti.
dhpak1.7:8.8: Thero “ kiṃ pana mayaṃ tayā kathitavatte vattissāmā ” ti
dhpak1.7:8.9: avatvā “ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati upāsike ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:9.2: sosānikehi nāma susāne vasanabhāvo susānagopakānañca vihāre mahātherassa ca gāmabhojakassa ca kathetuṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti.
dhpak1.7:9.3: vihāre mahātherassa ca gāmabhojakassa ca kathetuṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti. “ Thero kiṃ kāraṇā ” ti?
dhpak1.7:9.4: “ Katakammā corā dhanasāmikehi padānupadaṃ anubaddhā susāne bhaṇḍakaṃ chaḍḍetvā palāyanti,
dhpak1.7:9.7: ‘ mayaṃ imassa bhaddantassa ettakaṃ nāma kālaṃ ettha vasanabhāvaṃ jānāma, acoro eso ’ ti
dhpak1.7:10.2: “ Bhante, susāne vasantena nāma ayyena macchamaṃsatilapiṭṭhatelaguḷādīni vajjetabbāni,
dhpak1.7:10.3: divā na niddāyitabbaṃ, kusītena na bhavitabbaṃ,
dhpak1.7:10.4: āraddhavīriyena bhavitabbaṃ, asaṭhena amāyāvinā hutvā kalyāṇajjhāsayena bhavitabbaṃ,
dhpak1.7:10.5: sāyaṃ sabbesu suttesu vihārato āgantabbaṃ, paccūsakāle sabbesu anuṭṭhitesuyeva vihāraṃ gantabbaṃ.
dhpak1.7:10.6: Sace, bhante, ayyo imasmiṃ ṭhāne evaṃ viharanto pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetuṃ sakkhissati,
dhpak1.7:10.7: sace matasarīraṃ ānetvā chaḍḍenti, ahaṃ kambalakūṭāgāraṃ āropetvā
dhpak1.7:10.9: No ce sakkhissati, citakaṃ āropetvā aggiṃ jāletvā saṅkunā ākaḍḍhitvā
dhpak1.7:10.10: bahi khipitvā pharasunā koṭṭetvā khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chinditvā aggimhi pakkhipitvā jhāpessāmī ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:10.12: ekaṃ pana rūpārammaṇaṃ disvā mayhaṃ katheyyāsī ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:11.2: Cūḷakāḷatthero pana uṭṭhāya samuṭṭhāya gharāvāsaṃ cinteti, puttadāraṃ anussarati.
dhpak1.7:11.3: “ Bhātiko me atibhāriyaṃ kammaṃ karotī ” ti cinteti.
dhpak1.7:12.3: Tamenaṃ ñātakādayo dārutelādīhi saddhiṃ sāyaṃ susānaṃ netvā
dhpak1.7:12.6: Sā tassā pārutavatthaṃ apanetvā taṃmuhuttamataṃ pīṇitapīṇitaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sarīraṃ disvā,
dhpak1.7:12.8: ti cintetvā gantvā theraṃ vanditvā,“ bhante, evarūpaṃ nāma ārammaṇaṃ atthi, oloketha ayyā ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:13.1: Thero “ sādhū ” ti vatvā pārupanaṃ nīharāpetvā
dhpak1.7:13.3: “ atipīṇitametaṃ rūpaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ aggimhi naṃ pakkhipitvā mahājālāhi gahitamattakāle mayhaṃ āroceyyāsī ”
dhpak1.7:14.3: Jālāya pahaṭapahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ kabaragāviyā viya sarīravaṇṇaṃ ahosi,
dhpak1.7:14.4: pādā namitvā olambiṃsu, hatthā paṭikuṭiṃsu, ūrunalāṭaṃ niccammaṃ ahosi.
dhpak1.7:14.5: Thero “ idaṃ sarīraṃ idāneva olokentānaṃ apariyantakaraṃ hutvā idāneva khayaṃ
dhpak1.7:14.6: pattaṃ vayaṃ pattan ” ti rattiṭṭhānaṃ gantvā nisīditvā khayavayaṃ sampassamāno –
dhpak1.7:15.2: Uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho ” ti.
dhpak1.7:17.2: cārikaṃ caramāno setabyaṃ gantvā siṃsapāvanaṃ pāvisi.
dhpak1.7:17.3: Cūḷakāḷassa bhariyāyo “ satthā kira anuppatto siṃsapāvanan ” ti sutvā
dhpak1.7:17.8: Buddhānañhi majjhimaṭṭhāne āsanaṃ paññāpetvā tassa dakkhiṇato sāriputtattherassa,
dhpak1.7:17.9: vāmato mahāmoggallānattherassa, tato paṭṭhāya ubhosu passesu bhikkhusaṅghassa āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ hoti.
dhpak1.7:17.11: “ cūḷakāḷa, tvaṃ purato gantvā āsanapaññattiṃ ācikkhā ” ti cūḷakāḷaṃ pesesi.
dhpak1.7:18.1: Tassa diṭṭhakālato paṭṭhāya gehajanā tena saddhiṃ parihāsaṃ karontā
dhpak1.7:18.2: nīcāsanāni saṅghattherassa koṭiyaṃ attharanti, uccāsanāni saṅghanavakassa koṭiyaṃ.
dhpak1.7:18.4: nīcāsanāni upari mā paññāpetha, uccāsanāni upari paññāpetha, nīcāsanāni heṭṭhā ” ti āha.
dhpak1.7:18.6: “ tvaṃ kiṃ karonto vicarasi, kiṃ tava āsanāni paññāpetuṃ na vaṭṭati,
dhpak1.7:18.7: tvaṃ kaṃ āpucchitvā pabbajito, kena pabbajitosi, kasmā idhāgatosī ”
dhpak1.7:19.2: ca mālācumbuṭakaṃ ṭhapetvā,“ gaccha satthāraṃ ānehi,
dhpak1.7:19.4: Na ciraṃ bhikkhubhāve ṭhatvā avassikova uppabbajitattā lajjituṃ na jānāti,
dhpak1.7:19.5: tasmā so tena ākappena nirāsaṅkova gantvā satthāraṃ
dhpak1.7:20.2: “ imāhi attano sāmiko gahito, mayampi amhākaṃ sāmikaṃ gaṇhissāmā ”
dhpak1.7:20.4: Tadā pana āsanapaññāpanatthaṃ añño bhikkhu agamāsi.
dhpak1.7:20.5: Tā tasmiṃ khaṇe okāsaṃ alabhitvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ nisīdāpetvā bhikkhaṃ adaṃsu.
dhpak1.7:20.6: Cūḷakāḷassa pana dve bhariyāyo, majjhimakāḷassa catasso, mahākāḷassa pana aṭṭha.
dhpak1.7:21.1: Bhikkhūpi bhattakiccaṃ kātukāmā nisīditvā bhattakiccamakaṃsu, bahi gantukāmā uṭṭhāya agamaṃsu.
dhpak1.7:21.2: Satthā pana nisīditvā bhattakiccaṃ kari. Tassa bhattakiccapariyosāne tā itthiyo,
dhpak1.7:21.3: “ bhante, mahākāḷo amhākaṃ anumodanaṃ katvā āgacchissati, tumhe purato gacchathā ” ti vadiṃsu.
dhpak1.7:21.4: Satthā “ sādhū ” ti vatvā purato agamāsi.
dhpak1.7:22.1: Gāmadvāraṃ patvā bhikkhū ujjhāyiṃsu “ kiṃ nāmetaṃ satthārā kataṃ,
dhpak1.7:22.2: ñatvā nu kho kataṃ, udāhu ajānitvā. Hiyyo cūḷakāḷassa purato gatattā pabbajjantarāyo jāto,
dhpak1.7:22.3: ajja aññassa purato gatattā antarāyo nāhosi.
dhpak1.7:22.6: karissati nu kho tassa pabbajjantarāyan ” ti.
dhpak1.7:23.1: Satthā tesaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā nivattitvā ṭhito “ kiṃ kathetha, bhikkhave ” ti pucchi.
dhpak1.7:23.2: Te tamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “ Kiṃ pana tumhe, bhikkhave, cūḷakāḷaṃ viya mahākāḷaṃ sallakkhethā ” ti?
dhpak1.7:23.3: “ Āma, bhante ”. Tassa hi dve pajāpatiyo, imassa aṭṭha.
dhpak1.7:23.4: “ Aṭṭhahi parikkhipitvā gahito kiṃ karissati, bhante ” ti? Satthā “ mā, bhikkhave, evaṃ avacuttha,
dhpak1.7:23.6: Mayhaṃ pana putto mahākāḷo asubhānupassī viharati, ghanaselapabbato viya acalo ”
dhpak1.7:24.1: 7. “ Subhānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ; Bhojanamhi cāmattaññuṃ,
dhpak1.7:24.2: kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ; Taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃva dubbalaṃ.
dhpak1.7:25.1: 7. “ Subhānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ; Bhojanamhi cāmattaññuṃ,
dhpak1.7:25.2: kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ; Taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃva dubbalaṃ.
dhpak1.7:26.1: 8. “ Asubhānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ; Bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ,
dhpak1.7:26.2: saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ; Taṃ ve nappasahatī māro, vāto selaṃva pabbatan ” ti.
dhpak1.7:27.2: Bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ, saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ; Taṃ ve nappasahatī māro,
dhpak1.7:28.1: Tāpi kho tassa purāṇadutiyikāyo theraṃ parivāretvā “ tvaṃ kaṃ āpucchitvā pabbajito,
dhpak1.7:28.5: nisinnāsanā vuṭṭhāya iddhiyā uppattitvā kūṭāgārakaṇṇikaṃ dvidhā bhinditvā ākāsenāgantvā
dhpak1.7:28.7: satthu suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sarīraṃ abhitthavanto ākāsato otaritvā tathāgatassa pāde vandi.
